components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      x-class-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.ValidPostcodeForCity @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.ValidAddressForm"
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's optional courtesy title, one of MR, MRS, MS or DR. When supplied it is
            prefixed to the last name to form the owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          pattern: "^(MR|MRS|MS|DR)$"
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility; when the
            structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is preferred and this flat value is ignored.
            On responses this is the composed, normalized address: the normalized 'addressLine1'
            with the normalized 'addressLine2' appended after a single space when present, or the
            normalized flat address otherwise.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            First line of the structured postal address (typically street number and name).
            Preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '10 King Street'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            Optional second line of the structured postal address (unit, suite, etc.), appended to
            the composed address after 'addressLine1' when present.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.TelephoneDigits"
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.Email"
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when supplied it must be valid for the
            owner's city per the fixed region ranges (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
            QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when not
            supplied. When supplied it must not be later than the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.PastOrPresent"
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth. Optional; when supplied it is used to derive the owner's
            'ageBand' relative to their registration date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already has the same
            last name and postcode (i.e. they share a household), bypassing the household-duplicate
            block. The owner is created as a declared household member and is not flagged as a
            possible duplicate. Write-only request flag; not persisted.
          type: boolean
          default: false
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, formed as '<title> <lastName>' when a title is on file,
                or just the last name when no title is given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for human reading as the calling code, a
                space, then the national digits grouped in threes.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted as '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the city, LAST3 the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the
                owner's customer code.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by owners that belong to the same household, computed
                deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over
                '<normalizedLastName>|<postcode>'. Owners with the same last name and postcode
                derive the same identifier.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's identity key used for duplicate detection, formed as
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>|<householdId or empty>'. Two owners are
                duplicates only when their whole identity keys are equal.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george@example.com|A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed when this owner was created sharing the
                same first name and last name, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted as '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the
                last two digits of the registration date's year.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, starting at 0. Gains 2 when an email address is
                on file, 1 when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0), 2 for a
                household of 3 or more members, and 3 once the owner's tenure exceeds 365 days.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4, derived from their
                membership points: level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3 for 4-5 points
                and 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's canonical region derived from their city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or
                'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name derived from their locality (region) using a
                fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the locality maps to no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email address is on
                file, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from their birth date relative to their
                registration date: 'MINOR' (under 18), 'ADULT' (18-64) or 'SENIOR' (65+).
                Present only when a birth date is on file.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether the owner was registered on a day that had already seen a high volume of
                registrations, i.e. more than 80 owners had already been created on the owner's
                registration date when this owner was created.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Whether, when this owner was created, an existing owner shared the same household
                (same last name and postcode) but with a different telephone (a soft match that is
                not a hard duplicate). An owner created as a declared household member (via
                'sharesHousehold') is never flagged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matches, i.e. the owner that shares this
                owner's last name and postcode with a different telephone. Present only when
                'possibleDuplicate' is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false; deleting
                the owner via DELETE marks this true while retaining the record.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:

          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '10 King Street'

          title: Address line 2
          description: >-

            the composed address after 'addressLine1' when present.

          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'

            QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'

          title: Registration date
          description: >-
